findings.summary: B paste layer: 127 flashes vs 275 copper (46%)
findings.description: B-side paste layer has significantly fewer flashes (127) than copper layer (275). This may indicate missing solder paste apertures.
findings.recommendation: Check solder paste aperture generation — missing apertures cause assembly defects.
